   201	def run_gate(repo_root: Path, record: track.PullRequest, *, allow_unreviewed: bool,
   202	             adjudicated: bool = False) -> str:
   203	    """Raise ``GateFailure`` unless the PR may merge; return the head SHA."""
   204	    meta = record.meta
   205	    record_dir = record.path.parent
   206	
   207	    if record.state != "open":
   208	        raise GateFailure(
   209	            f"PR #{record.id} is {record.state!r}, not open; nothing to merge."
   210	        )
   211	
   212	    branch = record.branch
   213	    if not branch:
   214	        raise GateFailure(f"PR #{record.id} has no branch recorded")
   215	    tip = git(repo_root, "rev-parse", "--verify", f"{branch}^{{commit}}", check=False)
   216	    if not tip:
   217	        raise GateFailure(
   218	            f"branch {branch!r} does not resolve in this repository; it may have "
   219	            "been deleted already."
   220	        )
   221	
   222	    head_sha = meta.get("head_sha")
   223	    if not head_sha:
   224	        raise GateFailure(
   225	            f"PR #{record.id} has head_sha: null. Run local/bin/ci.sh on the branch "
   226	            "so the record names the commit that was tested."
   227	        )
   228	    if str(head_sha) != tip:
   229	        raise GateFailure(
   230	            f"head_sha {str(head_sha)[:12]} does not match the branch tip "
   231	            f"{tip[:12]}. New commits landed after the recorded CI/review; re-run "
   232	            "local/bin/ci.sh and local/bin/review.sh (DESIGN.md:66-69)."
   233	        )
   234	
   235	    ci_status = meta.get("ci_status")
   236	    if ci_status != "success":
   237	        raise GateFailure(
   238	            f"ci_status is {ci_status!r}, not 'success'. Run local/bin/ci.sh "
   239	            f"{record.id} and merge only on green."
   240	        )
   241	    ci_dir = record_dir / "ci"
   242	    manifest = ci_dir / f"{head_sha}.json"
   243	    if not ci_dir.is_dir():
   244	        raise GateFailure(
   245	            f"{ci_dir} does not exist. The frontmatter claims success but there is "
   246	            "no per-SHA manifest to back it; run local/bin/ci.sh."
   247	        )
   248	    if not manifest.is_file():
   249	        raise GateFailure(
   250	            f"no CI manifest at {manifest}. ci_status in frontmatter is a summary; "
   251	            "the manifest for the exact head SHA is the evidence."
   252	        )
   253	
   254	    review_state = meta.get("review_state")
   255	    if kill_switch_disabled("LOCAL_REVIEW_ENABLED"):
   256	        if not allow_unreviewed:
   257	            raise GateFailure(
   258	                "LOCAL_REVIEW_ENABLED=false, so no verdict can be produced. The "
   259	                "gate does not silently waive review: re-enable reviews, or merge "
   260	                "with --allow-unreviewed, which records the waiver in the PR."
   261	            )
   262	        sys.stderr.write(
   263	            "warning: merging with review disabled and --allow-unreviewed given\n"
   264	        )
   265	    elif review_state == "blocked":
   266	        raise GateFailure(
   267	            "review_state is 'blocked': CI failed, so review was refused rather "
   268	            "than skipped (DESIGN.md:66-69). Fix CI first."
   269	        )
   270	    elif not review_state:
   271	        raise GateFailure(
   272	            f"PR #{record.id} has review_state: null. Run local/bin/review.sh "
   273	            f"{record.id} on the current head SHA."
   274	        )
   275	    else:
   276	        check_review_verdict(record_dir, str(head_sha), str(review_state),
   277	                             adjudicated=adjudicated)
   278	
   279	    check_fix_gates(repo_root, record_dir, meta)
   280	    return str(head_sha)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regression tests for the consolidated issue automation workflow."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
WORKFLOW = REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "issue-automation.yml"


class IssueAutomationWorkflowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        cls.text = WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    def test_tracking_does_not_manage_inactive_all_resolved_label(self) -> None:
        self.assertNotIn("labels: ['all-resolved']", self.text)
        self.assertNotIn("name: 'all-resolved'", self.text)
        self.assertNotRegex(self.text, r"\b(addLabels|removeLabel)\b[\s\S]{0,200}all-resolved")

    def test_tracking_paginates_sub_issues_and_comments(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("subIssues(first:100, after:$after)", self.text)
        self.assertIn("pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }", self.text)
        self.assertRegex(self.text, r"while|for\s*\(\s*;;\s*\)")
        self.assertIn("github.paginate(\n                github.rest.issues.listComments", self.text)

    def test_tracking_restores_pr_referenced_tracking_issues(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("async function trackingIssuesReferencingPR", self.text)
        self.assertIn("github.rest.issues.listForRepo", self.text)
        self.assertIn("labels: 'tracking'", self.text)
        self.assertIn("trackingIssuesReferencingPR(pr.number)", self.text)

    def test_pr_opened_skips_bot_branch_announcements(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("function skipPrOpenedAnnouncement", self.text)
        self.assertIn("/^(claude|codex)\\//", self.text)
        self.assertIn("if (skipPrOpenedAnnouncement(pr))", self.text)

    def test_pr_comment_markers_are_substrings_of_posted_bodies(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn(
            "`PR #${pr.number} (*${pr.title}*) has been opened`,", self.text
        )
        self.assertIn(
            "`PR #${pr.number} (*${pr.title}*) addressing this issue has been merged`,",
            self.text,
        )

    def test_scout_runs_after_classification_failure(self) -> None:
        scout_if = re.search(r"  scout:\n(?P<body>[\s\S]*?)\n    runs-on:", self.text)
        self.assertIsNotNone(scout_if)
        body = scout_if.group("body")
        self.assertIn("always() && !cancelled()", body)
        self.assertNotIn("needs['classify-trusted'].result != 'cancelled'", body)

    def test_track_job_serializes_issue_state_changes(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("concurrency:\n      group: issue-automation-track-", self.text)
        self.assertIn("cancel-in-progress: false", self.text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

   205	Three subcommands, all writing atomically (tempfile in the destination

   207	half-written manifest or a truncated PR record behind:
   208	
   209	  manifest        assemble prs/<id>/ci/<head_sha>.json from a step TSV

   231	
   232	def atomic_write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
   233	    """Write *text* to *path* via a same-directory tempfile and os.replace."""
   234	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   235	    handle, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(
   236	        dir=str(path.parent), prefix=path.name + ".", suffix=".tmp"
   237	    )
   238	    try:
   239	        with os.fdopen(handle, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
   240	            stream.write(text)
   241	            stream.flush()
   242	            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
   243	        os.replace(tmp_name, path)
   244	    except BaseException:
   245	        try:
   246	            os.unlink(tmp_name)
   247	        except OSError:

   258	    """Return (opening, body_lines, rest) or None when there is no frontmatter."""
   259	    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
   260	    if not lines or lines[0].strip() != FENCE:
   261	        return None
   262	    for index in range(1, len(lines)):
   263	        if lines[index].strip() == FENCE:
   264	            return lines[:1], lines[1:index], lines[index:]
   265	    return None

   271	        return None
   272	    _, body, _ = split
   273	    prefix = key + ":"
   274	    for line in body:
   275	        if line.startswith(prefix):
   276	            value = line[len(prefix):].strip()
   277	            if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in "'\"":
   278	                value = value[1:-1]
   279	            return value

   405	def cmd_telemetry(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
   406	    record = {}
   407	    for item in args.field or []:
   408	        key, _, value = item.partition("=")
   409	        record[key] = value
   410	    for key in args.int_field or []:
   411	        if key in record:
   412	            try:
   413	                record[key] = int(record[key])
   414	            except ValueError:
   415	                pass
   416	    path = Path(args.out)
   417	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   418	    # One line, one write: concurrent appenders never interleave a short line.
   419	    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
   420	        stream.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
   421	    return 0

   424	def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
   425	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
   426	    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
   427	
   428	    manifest = subparsers.add_parser("manifest", help="assemble the per-SHA CI manifest")
   429	    manifest.add_argument("--out", required=True)
   430	    manifest.add_argument("--steps-tsv", required=True)
   431	    manifest.add_argument("--pr", required=True)
   432	    manifest.add_argument("--pr-dir", required=True)
   433	    manifest.add_argument("--branch", required=True)
   434	    manifest.add_argument("--base", required=True)
   435	    manifest.add_argument("--base-ref", required=True)
   436	    manifest.add_argument("--merge-base", required=True)
   437	    manifest.add_argument("--head-sha", required=True)
   438	    manifest.add_argument("--worktree", required=True)
   439	    manifest.add_argument("--started", required=True)
   440	    manifest.add_argument("--finished", required=True)
   441	    manifest.add_argument("--seconds", type=int, required=True)
   442	    manifest.add_argument("--conclusion", required=True)
   443	    manifest.add_argument("--area", action="append", default=[], metavar="NAME=0|1")
   444	    manifest.add_argument("--changed-files-file")
   445	    manifest.add_argument("--warnings-file")
   446	    manifest.add_argument("--partial", type=int, default=0, choices=(0, 1))
   447	    manifest.set_defaults(func=cmd_manifest)
   448	
   449	    frontmatter = subparsers.add_parser("frontmatter", help="read or set frontmatter keys")
   450	    frontmatter.add_argument("--file", required=True)
   451	    frontmatter.add_argument("--get")
   452	    frontmatter.add_argument("--set", action="append", metavar="KEY=VALUE")
   453	    frontmatter.set_defaults(func=cmd_frontmatter)
   454	
   455	    telemetry = subparsers.add_parser("telemetry", help="append one JSONL record")
   456	    telemetry.add_argument("--out", required=True)
   457	    telemetry.add_argument("--field", action="append", default=[], metavar="KEY=VALUE")
   458	    telemetry.add_argument("--int-field", action="append", default=[], metavar="KEY")
   459	    telemetry.set_defaults(func=cmd_telemetry)
   460	
   461	    return parser
   462	
   463	
   464	def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
   465	    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
   466	    return args.func(args)
